summary: In commercial launch developments, Rocket Lab has pushed the targeted inaugural flight of its next-generation Neutron rocket to 2027. In civil space, NASA named Stephen Cash as the new director of the Marshall Space Flight Center, while the crew of the Artemis II mission received the Stephen Hawking Medal at the Starmus festival. Military aviation developments saw an Air Force F-22 pilot direct a Collaborative Combat Aircraft in flight, Germany shift course on plans to purchase Boeing’s MQ-28 drone wingman, and Turkish Aerospace expand production lines for an upgraded Anka 3 drone. In scientific research, scientists published the first comprehensive Mars soil classification framework to guide future exploration and farming, simulations analyzed nuclear mitigation strategies for hazardous asteroids, experiments revealed rapid gene activity shifts in plants upon entering spaceflight, and astronomers detected atmospheric "gemstones" on a scorching exoplanet. Additionally, researchers are deploying deep learning models to better forecast air drag and predict when uncontrolled satellites and rocket stages will fall to Earth, while propulsion startup RATLOG aims to cut rocket engine part counts by roughly 90 percent. Looking ahead, skywatchers should monitor the night sky as the annual Orionid meteor shower reaches its peak this week.
